entries.causal_hypothesis: After executable profit is established, simultaneous nonpositive side-aligned four-M15-open momentum, MACD histogram and price-to-EMA20 distance should identify P2/P1 failure early enough to improve target losses while preserving Winner tail and breadth across four folds.
entries.decision: Close HYP-024 and Family O. No candidate, MT4 parity or 2025 gate is authorized.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: target-class improvement is specific enough to preserve portfolio Winner tail
one common finite state-collapse rule is portable across B02/F05, both directions and all sub-periods
P2 and P1 may be rescued by choosing an isolated cell or combining arms after outcomes
entries.origin_analysis: The accepted B02/F05 population separated P3 Entry failure from P2 early failure and P1 giveback. P3 local Entry technical factors were already closed; HYP-024 froze a finite post-profit state-collapse Exit family before outcomes.
pre_result_predictions: P2 and P1 target-class benefit positive in every fold
top-decile Winner retention at least 0.90 in every fold
B02/F05 and long/short deltas nonnegative in every fold
both quarter deltas nonnegative in every fold
at least one within-arm adjacent core component with a full cell
prohibited_reuse: do not repair HYP-024 by changing indicator thresholds, components, arms, quorum, persistence or gates
do not combine P2 and P1 candidates after outcomes
do not use isolated target-class benefit to justify MT4 or 2025
do not access 2025 or run MT4 without a future separately authorized Research finalist
retained_findings: the state-collapse primitives consistently identify deterioration in P2 and P1 target losses
the same primitives also fire during ordinary Winner pullbacks
P2 Q3/R2 preserves top-decile Winner profit in all folds but still fails total delta and breadth
P1 has severe Winner-tail sacrifice and zero quarter-breadth passes across 16 fold-cells
successor_questions: Can a genuinely distinct mechanism distinguish ordinary Winner pullback from terminal directional-state collapse without using HYP-024 threshold refinements?
